description: A carousel control for Uno Platform, proposed for the Uno Toolkit, styled after the Control Gallery "Carousel" sheet: mounted plates (a mat, a hairline ring and a soft shadow) on a track that glides 700 ms with the next plate peeking in, the caption kept off the image beside the track (below it under 720 px), a thumbnail strip with auto-play progress bars, and previous / pause / next buttons with a status. Auto-play advances every 6 s and holds on hover and focus; arrows, Home, End and Space work from the keyboard, and swipe moves the track with the finger. Plates have Loading and Image failed states with a Try again button, titles clamp at two lines. Instrument Serif and Instrument Sans are bundled; Light is the sheet's paper palette and Dark keeps it on charcoal. Overlay mode with slide and fade transitions, vertical orientation and an automation peer remain.

showcase.summary: A plate carousel with a peeking track, captions beside the image, thumbnails with auto-play progress and load states.
goals: A templated control whose default style carries the design: tokens in Light and Default theme dictionaries, bundled fonts, keyed caption text styles
Track mode (ItemPeek, ItemSpacing) with a 700 ms KeySpline glide, inactive items at 72 % and swipe that follows the finger
A side or bottom layout chosen from the control's own width (CaptionPlacement Auto), so it works at 390 px
Auto-play that holds on hover and focus, keeps the remaining time and shows progress on the current thumbnail (PlaybackState, IsPaused)
Item states as VisualStates on CarouselPlate (Ready, Loading, Failed) with a RetryRequested event
Keyboard (arrows, Home, End, Space), a polite live position label and named buttons
Hot Design previews of each state, a runtime Light/Dark switch and {utu:Responsive} sizes on the host page
